description: Bounded readiness preflight for Arizona ADHS monthly Child Care Centers and Child Care Group Homes XLSX tables.
retry: No retries, redirects, alternate hosts, inferred future-month URLs, workbook bodies, GIS fallbacks, or record requests.
checkpoint: One official catalog body and two exact XLSX HEAD responses are validated; bodies of the facility tables are never requested.
idempotency: Each observation uses a unique UUID directory and exclusive-create artifacts.
cancellation: Abort is checked before every request, while reading the catalog, and before publication.
retention_profile: Catalog statement and workbook headers only; zero provider rows, addresses, contacts, ZIP observations, or coordinates.
